subject.title: fix: filter braille characters from usage bar to prevent markdown rendering issues (#105481)

question: Should this revised PR land as a standalone regression-test guard after removing its bug-fix and closing claims, or should it close while the actual WebChat rendering bug is investigated separately?
rationale: The branch now contains potentially useful boundary coverage but no behavior fix; whether that coverage merits a standalone PR is a maintainer scope decision rather than an automated repair choice.

options.title: Keep the narrow test guard
options.body: Retitle and rewrite the PR as regression coverage, remove the closing reference, and require branch-head live proof that the supported braille footer still renders correctly.

options.title: Close the branch
options.body: Close this PR because it no longer addresses the linked issue, and continue root-cause work in the canonical issue with live WebChat diagnostics.
